20261122-chemistry-e2-2.material: Kutheni, nokuba amanzi neoli yokupheka zifakwe kwibhotile enye zaza zashukunyiswa ngamandla, zaphinda zahlukana ngokupheleleyo zibe ngamacandelo amabini xa zishiywa zikhululekile?
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.prompt: Kutheni, nokuba amanzi neoli yokupheka zifakwe kwibhotile enye zaza zashukunyiswa ngamandla, zaphinda zahlukana ngokupheleleyo zibe ngamacandelo amabini xa zishiywa zikhululekile?
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.explain: Amanzi ayimolekyuli ye-polar, ioli yokupheka ibe yimolekyuli ye-non-polar ngoko azixutywa, kwaye ukuxinana kweoli yokupheka (malunga ne-0.92 g/cm³) kuphantsi kwamanzi (1.0 g/cm³) ngoko ibhabha kumgangatho ongaphezulu.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Amanzi ayi-polar ize ioli ibe yi-non-polar ngoko azinyibiliki.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Ioli ilula kunamanzi (ayixinene kangako) ngoko ibhabha ngaphezulu.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Kuba ioli yokupheka ayixutywa namanzi kwaye ayixinene kunamanzi ngoko ibhabha ngaphezulu
